steps.path: Big picture tab, as it first opens
steps.headline: As each first opens: which of these is worth keeping, alone or combined with another?
steps.notice: Each was built by a different agent from your own words and the same status facts. Pick every one with an idea worth keeping; your note can say which parts to combine.
steps.risk: The status facts are from Oct 12 and gathered by hand; the real version reads them from the work cards.

variants.label: Zoom in
variants.summary: Ten boxes, one per major system, sized by how much they hold. Each small square is one feature, coloured by where it stands. Click a system to zoom inside it.
variants.risk: Every feature counts the same, so a one-line idea takes as much room as a big finished feature.

variants.label: Journeys
variants.summary: Seven things real people would do, each a row of steps. Each row shows how far you get today and where it stops; the side lists which systems stop the most journeys.
variants.risk: Only 33 of the 168 features sit on any journey, so a system no journey passes through is invisible.

variants.label: Foundations up
variants.summary: A building: what everything rests on at the bottom, the big ideas at the top. A block missing its support hangs on dashed legs. A strip at the top ranks what to build next.
variants.risk: Dense and wordy; only about a quarter of features have a known dependency, so the rest sit in an "everything else" list.

variants.label: How it's wired
variants.summary: The app's 13 real parts and how they connect, taken from the actual code. Pick "follow a message", "follow a sync" or "follow a marketplace install" to step through one path.
variants.risk: Shows how the app works today far better than how far it is from the vision; only 3 unbuilt things appear.

steps.path: Big picture tab, after one click
steps.headline: After one click: which of these tells you something you actually want to know?
steps.notice: Zoom in: inside Sync and Mesh. Journeys: one step opened. Foundations up: one block lit with what holds it up. How it's wired: step 4 of following a marketplace install.

variants.label: Zoom in
variants.summary: Every feature of one system by name and status, with lines to the other systems it needs.

variants.label: Journeys
variants.summary: One step's system, what it needs first, and which journeys it matters to.

variants.label: Foundations up
variants.summary: What holds one block up, what it holds up, and which of those are unfinished.

variants.label: How it's wired
variants.summary: One step of a path through the app, lit up, with a plain sentence for what happens there.
